verdict.rationale: Foreloop's architecture has the agent (Claude Code or Codex) run locally on the engineering-lead's own machine, and its MCP endpoint is described as usable by any MCP client with just a URL and API key — implying model/agent choice is left to the user rather than locked to a single vendor model. However, there is no explicit documentation of configuring a custom LLM provider or API key within Foreloop itself, only mention of the two named agent options and generic MCP compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit docs on supplying a custom API key/model endpoint, list of supported LLM providers beyond Claude Code/Codex, and any pricing/limits tie-in for BYO-model usage.
